name: dotclaude-browser
description: Drives a browser with `agent-browser`, or with CloakBrowser on sites with bot detection. Answers each `WebSearch` call with a search in the headless browser. With the `cloakbrowser` backend, `WebSearch` needs the CloakBrowser binary.

backend.title: Browser backend
backend.description: Use `agent-browser`, or `cloakbrowser` for sites with bot detection. CloakBrowser runs through `agent-browser` with its own Chromium binary. With `cloakbrowser`, `WebSearch` needs that binary.
